blocks.text: Talar, Edrin, Nemi, and the distributed students

Origin / identity. Talar of the Sixth Resonance is a Keeper of Living Language. Councilor Edrin governs amid loss of Full Speech. Nemi, Sava, Orin, Pell, Ina, and Var retain different fragments of one chord.

Importance. Edrin’s standardization protects access while accelerating semantic loss. Talar proves partial speakers can preserve relationships among meanings without reproducing the original speaker or complete form.

Final status. The complete chord leaves ordinary life. Nemi’s two notes mean “keep this open,” “not yet,” and “do not finish it for me,” without exhausting the older meaning. The speakers’ later fates are unrecorded; their function survives in Old Sound traditions.
